CustomField.description: Ready = all MUST-HAVEs Yes + digital logger + distributor serviceable, audited within $CustomMetadata.Acaroid_Formula_Config__mdt.Default.Audit_Staleness_Days__c (default 180) days. Conditional = MUST-HAVEs Yes but manual log or distributor pending. Else Not Ready.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(AND(Acaroid_Has_2_8C_Fridge__c, Acaroid_Has_Emergency_Kit__c, Acaroid_Anaphylaxis_Trained_Staff__c, Acaroid_Has_Observation_Area__c)),'Not Ready',IF(OR(ISBLANK(Acaroid_Readiness_Audit_Date__c), Acaroid_Readiness_Audit_Date__c < TODAY() - $CustomMetadata.Acaroid_Formula_Config__mdt.Default.Audit_Staleness_Days__c),'Conditional',IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Acaroid_Temp_Monitoring__c, 'Digital data logger'), Acaroid_Cold_Chain_Serviceable__c), 'Ready', 'Conditional')))
CustomField.label: Administration Readiness Status
